working_definition: Tm9a is one of two transcriptomic subtypes of Tm9, narrow-field transmedullary interneurons of the adult Drosophila visual system. It arborises dendritically in medulla layers M2-M3 and projects to the dorsal half of lobula layer 1, providing cholinergic input to T5 neurons. The Tm9a subtype is defined by expression of the Wnt ligand Wnt10 (distinguishing it from Tm9b, which expresses Wnt4 and targets the ventral lobula). This subtype split was first described in Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the dorsal half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt10 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).

justification: FBbt:00058233 was defined directly from Kurmangaliyev et al. 2020 — the same paper as this atlas. Its two defining criteria (Wnt10 expression; dorsal half of lobula targeting) are identical to those that distinguish the Tm9a cluster from Tm9b in this dataset. The FBbt label matches the cluster label exactly. There is no ambiguity about correspondence: same paper, same discriminating marker, same anatomical criterion. Per the provenance rule for same-paper FBbt subtypes with matching criteria (cf. Tm9b -> FBbt:00058234), this is an exact match with high confidence. No curator verification or new term is needed.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that has most of its dendritic arborization in medulla layers M2 and M3, with some extensions into M1, M4 and M5 (Gao et al., 2008; Ting et al., 2014), and presynapses in M3 (Gao et al., 2008). Its axon follows the posterior edge of its cognate medulla column (Ting et al., 2014), then crosses in the second optic chiasma and terminates in lobula layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Ting et al., 2014), where it outputs to T5 neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2014). It is a cholinergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008; Shinomiya et al., 2014). It expresses the transcription factor sim (Ozel et al., 2021). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent term covering all Tm9 neurons; does not capture the Tm9a-specific Wnt10 expression or dorsal lobula restriction. Too broad given that the exact subtype term FBbt:00058233 exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the ventral half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt4 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Sibling subtype, not the same cell. Tm9b is defined by Wnt4 expression and ventral lobula targeting — the opposite of this cluster's defining features.
